# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. A blocker applies, so the score is capped at 40. The blocker is that a search crawler (Googlebot) is blocked site-wide. This is a small SvelteKit site with three routes: `/`, `/shop` and `/search`. I read all of it, so nothing is unknown. Two problems cost most of the points. `robots.txt` tells Google to stay away from the whole site. And the pages are built in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript get an empty page. These results are read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `robots.txt` is the file crawlers read first. This rule tells Google not to read any page, so none of your pages can be found through Google search. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 72/100 (Good). This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 and removes the 40 cap: earned 18 ÷ 25. ### 2. Render pages on the server instead of only in the browser - **Why it matters:** many crawlers read only the first HTML the server sends. With rendering off, that HTML is an empty shell, so they see no heading, text or links. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small. Remove the line, or use prerendering for these static pages. - **Score after this:** 84/100 once items 1 and 2 are both done (earned 21 ÷ 25). On its own it stays at 40, because the cap still applies. ### 3. Set the page language and fill in the missing basics - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells machines which language the pages are in. An empty description gives them nothing to show for `/shop`. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` (no `lang`) and `` - **Size:** Small. Add `lang="en"` and write a real description. - **Score after this:** 92/100 once items 1 to 3 are done (earned 23 ÷ 25). Fixing the Product data below as well gives 100/100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is readable and valid | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt`: valid lines, tiny file | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:5` `Disallow: /` under Googlebot. No `geo.config.json`, so I assumed you want to be found. | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are both blocked for Googlebot (`static/robots.txt:4-5`). `/search` has noindex on purpose and isn't in the sitemap or nav, so I left it out. | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your own domain | Clear | Not run | `+page.svelte:4` and `shop/+page.svelte:4`, both on `https://quay.example` (2 of 2 routes). | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` `export const ssr = false;` and `src/app.html:8` `
%sveltekit.body%
`. All 3 routes. | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid and complete | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: a Product with only `"name":"Bilge pump"`. Google's Product guidance also asks for `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is discoverable | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid, and `static/robots.txt:7` has an absolute `Sitemap:` line. | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` are present | Problem | Not run | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang` (all routes). `shop/+page.svelte:3` has an empty description. `/search` has no description. | | GEO-016 | Key pages are reachable by real links | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has `Shop`. | | GEO-017 | No snippet limits that conflict with AI search | Clear | Not run | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element (`+layout.svelte:7`), which is a deliberate choice. No headers or middleware set `X-Robots-Tag`. | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | I read the layout and all 3 pages. There are no images, links have text, and every page has a title. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared. | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not run | No `llms.txt` found. It's optional and isn't scored. | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app. | ## Other problems found - **Product data on a listing page:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` has `"@type":"Product","name":"Bilge pump"`. `/shop` lists several items ("Bilge pumps, cleats and rope."), so a single Product label describes the page wrongly. Either remove it or move it to a page for one product, with a price. ## Worth considering - **Add `
` and a viewport tag:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:6` has `{@render children()}` loose inside a `
`, and `src/app.html:4` has only ``. Wrapping the content in `
` and adding `` might help machines and phones read the page structure. - **Give each product its own page:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9` has `Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.` Items that exist only as a sentence can't be linked to or found individually. Separate pages with a name, price and photo might help people and machines. - **Say more about the delivery claim:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7` has `Marine parts, shipped next day`, and `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` has `Free delivery over £50.` The claim is on the home page, but nothing in readable text explains cut-off times or regions. A short delivery page might answer what a buyer would ask. - **Add share tags to the home page:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:2-4` sets a title and description but no `og:title` or `og:description`. These might make shared links look better. - **Keep `/search` as it is:** `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:3` is `noindex` on purpose, so I left it alone. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes:** whether `/`, `/shop` and the sitemap really answer 200, and whether hosting adds `X-Robots-Tag` headers. A live scan with your URL would show this. - **Domain:** I assumed `quay.example` is your real domain, because the canonicals, sitemap and robots file all agree. If it's a placeholder, the canonicals and sitemap need the real one. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. There's no `geo.config.json` to say otherwise. - The blocked Googlebot rule is a mistake. If it's deliberate, say so, and GEO-009 and GEO-014 would be judged differently. - Hosting doesn't prerender the pages, so `ssr = false` really does give crawlers an empty shell. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
